title: Optimal risk-aware interest rates for decentralized lending protocols
abstract: arXiv:2502.19862v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Interest rates in decentralized lending protocols are set algorithmically and adjust to supply and demand for liquidity. In this study, we propose an optimal interest rate model that maximizes the expected lender wealth while incorporating penalties for liquidity risk and interest rate stabilization. This objective benefits both sides of the market: it improves yield and reduces liquidity risk for lenders, while encouraging borrower activity indirectly through higher utilization and directly through stabilized borrowing costs. The dynamics of the utilization rate are modeled using point processes whose intensities depend on the interest rate. When intensities are linear, the optimal interest rate model is derived from a system of Riccati-type ODEs. In the nonlinear case, we approximate it using a Monte-Carlo estimator coupled with deep learning techniques. Finally, using block-by-block data, we conduct a risk-adjusted profit and loss

translated_title: 去中心化借贷协议的最优风险感知利率
translated_abstract: arXiv:2502.19862v2 公告类型：替换 摘要：去中心化借贷协议中的利率由算法设定，并根据流动性供需进行调整。在本研究中，我们提出了一种最优利率模型，该模型在纳入流动性风险和利率稳定化惩罚的同时，最大化贷款人的预期财富。这一目标使市场双方受益：它为贷款人提高收益并降低流动性风险，同时通过更高的利用率间接鼓励借款人活动，并通过稳定的借款成本直接鼓励借款人活动。利用率动态使用点过程建模，其强度依赖于利率。当强度为线性时，最优利率模型由Riccati型常微分方程组推导得出。在非线性情况下，我们使用蒙特卡洛估计器结合深度学习技术对其进行近似。最后，利用逐块数据，我们进行了风险调整后的盈亏分析。
tldr: 本文提出了一种最优利率模型，通过平衡流动性风险与利率稳定，最大化贷款人预期财富，并利用点过程和深度学习技术进行建模与优化。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an optimal interest rate model that maximizes lender expected wealth by balancing liquidity risk and rate stabilization, using point processes and deep learning for modeling and optimization.
